description: Change a logged food’s amount (grams), display measure, or diary group. serving_id and date come from get_diary.

date.description: A date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday", or "N days ago" (resolved in the diary timezone).

diary_group.description: Diary group 1–4 (by default Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snacks).

serving_id.description: A Cronometer id from an earlier tool result.
